industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Westbridge Renewable Energy Corp.
summary: Westbridge Renewable Energy Corp. develops and acquires solar photovoltaic projects in Canada and the United States. Its main asset is the 278 MWp Georgetown project in Vulcan County, Alberta. It fully owns the 221 MWp Accalia project in Cameron County, Texas, and holds 75% of the 236 MWp Sunnynook Project in Alberta, which includes a 100 MW battery storage system.
